name: Mem0
description: Connect Mem0 to Claude to give your agent persistent memory across sessions. Claude can store user preferences, project context, and conversation history, then search, update, or forget them as new information comes in. Useful for coding assistants that remember your codebase conventions, support agents that recall customer history, research workflows that build context over weeks, or any use case where Claude resets back to zero today. Memories are scoped per user, agent, or session. Cloud-hosted, no local install.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**.

- **Skills** (5): `mem0` (Mem0 Platform SDK for adding persistent memory to AI applications), `mem0-cli` (Mem0 CLI -- the command-line interface for mem0 memory operations), `mem0-integrate` (Integrate Mem0 into an existing repository using a goal-driven, TDD pipeline), `mem0-test-integration` (Verify a Mem0 integration produced by /mem0-integrate), `mem0-vercel-ai-sdk` (Mem0 provider for Vercel AI SDK (@mem0/vercel-ai-provider))

Installs with `claude plugin install mem0@claude-community` from `mem0ai/mem0`.
